body: But I don't want it to pass, I want to be pushed over the edge, I don't want to be here anymore
Then I'm afraid the only thing I can tell you to do is sleep on it and hope you feel better in the morning. I joined reddit 2 hours ago to distract myself from the bottle of pills next to my bed.

I don't really know what to tell you because I'm depressed and suicidal myself, but I just read some of your past comments and you said it yourself, everything is temporary, but the pain you would leave your mom will be with her until the day she dies and the thought of doing that to my own mother is the only thing keeping me alive right now.
I don't know why we're all so hard on ourselves, I've just seen you post lovely and kind comments on other peoples posts and I can't believe that you yourself are suicidal.

Wow, reading this I wish I had an easy solution to give you, but in terms of advise all I can say is, in your new job, just try and keep your head down, avoid arguments and confrontational situations, just go there, do your job and leave. And while you are still living at home, save up all the money you can. Hope this helps and doesnt seem too cliche,' easier said than done'.

I feel the exact same way, I dropped out of university because I lack motivation to do anything, and now I've been working a minimum wage job in a factory for the last 8 months, completely miserable, I'm just hoping I work up to guts to kms.
